modules.name: Parallax Layers
modules.description: A layered section where the background drifts slower than the foreground as you scroll past.

modules.name: Reveal Mask
modules.description: Content that unmasks into view, left to right, the first time you scroll it into the viewport.

modules.name: Scroll Progress Trace
modules.description: A slender line fixed to the edge of the page that fills as the visitor reads down.
